data.one_liner: A high-performance, interactive Flutter candlestick chart for financial apps.
data.what_it_does: Renders interactive OHLCV candlestick charts with support for mobile and desktop gestures, crosshair interaction, panning, zooming, volume bars, and logarithmic or linear price scales.
use_when: You need to display financial candlestick charts in a Flutter app.
You require interactive features like zooming, panning, and crosshair selection.
avoid_when: You need general-purpose line, bar, or pie charts rather than financial candlesticks.
Your dataset does not use OHLCV financial formatting.
strengths: High performance with interactive mobile and desktop gestures.
Supports both linear and logarithmic price scales.
Includes lazy loading and controller-based viewport control.
weaknesses: Specialized exclusively for candlestick charts, limiting flexibility for other chart types.
Requires candles to be strictly ordered from newest to oldest.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a wide variety of standard chart types like line, bar, and pie charts.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need an enterprise-grade charting library with financial chart support and many other chart types.
